sections.text: Introduction

These
procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper operation
and calibration of IRU1 -AC voltage Relay. It is recommended this procedure be
carried out every four years bases the first preliminary steps to prepare for
relay testing describes the activates required prior
to testing.

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Moustafa Osman ,tested and revised by eng.Ali Ghater , accepted by eng. Farag 
Abo Youseff :general manager, approved by eng. Gomaa Ghater: head sector of Kafr 
el Dawar Power Station, 
and certified by eng. Gaber Mohmed Frahat : WDEPC inspection and quality 
control general director and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions

items: The equipment isolation is required.
A work permit must be issued
The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Personal safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, safety 
 helmet ... etc

sections.text: Testing Procedures

Isolate the secondary terminal of the
voltage transformer.

Connect the voltage test set terminals to
phase R (A3) ,phase S ( A5 ) and phase T (A7)

Inject the three phase voltage (each
phase = 57.7 V) to the relay then decrease the voltage to phase R gradually
until the red flag for phase R appears then record VR (pick - up)

Increase
the voltage to phase R gradually until
the red flag disappear then record VR (reset)
Repeat the steps (3,4) for the phases (S , T )

Inject the three phase voltage (each phase = 57.7V)
to the relay then increase the voltage to phase R gradually until the red flag
for phase R appears then record VR (pick
- up) and time .

Decrease the voltage to phase R gradually until the red flag disappear then
record VR (reset)

Repeat the steps (6,7) for the
phases (S , T )

test terminal .

Make sure VT secondary circuits are in
normal condition.

If any equipment associated with the
relay has been isolated, it should be returned to service.

sections_ar.text: يوضح هذا الإجراء الخطوات اللازمة للتحقق الكامل من سلامة تشغيل ريلاي الجهد المتردد IRU1 ومعايرته، ويُوصى بتنفيذ هذا الإجراء كل أربع سنوات، وتصف الخطوات التمهيدية الأولى للتحضير لاختبار الريلاي الأنشطة المطلوبة قبل الاختبار.

أعد المسودة الأولى م. Moustafa Osman، واختبرها وراجعها م. Ali Ghater، وقبلها م. Farag Abo Youseff: مدير عام، واعتمدها م. Gomaa Ghater: رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء كفر الدوار، وصدّق عليها م. Gaber Mohmed Frahat: مدير عام التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة بشركة غرب الدلتا لإنتاج الكهرباء ومنسق نظام معلومات إجراءات الصيانة.
